description: Is this skill, agent package or MCP server safe to install? Give a skill.md / SKILL.md URL, a GitHub repo or an MCP endpoint (or paste the text). Returns a verdict (safe / caution / unsafe) and a 0-100 safety score, line-level findings for credential reads, exfiltration destinations, shell execution, curl-pipe-sh, obfuscation, hidden instructions aimed at the agent, wallet or approval requests, host writes and disabled TLS, a permission manifest (filesystem, network, shell, credentials, payments, every external host named), and an AI review comparing the claimed purpose with the actual behaviour, with quotes. For MCP servers the tool descriptions and instructions are judged for injection. Unreachable or empty sources are not charged. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402).
